text: I order medium-rare steak at a restaurant, and they bring me well-done chicken. I just eat it. So do I. Who gives a shit? So do I. Same way. Somebody cuts me off in traffic and then flips me off. I'm like, wow, they need bigger problems. Traffic is bugging you that much. You'll never be successful, so know that. If you're annoyed because a friend doesn't ask you to go to the mall, or someone cuts you off in traffic, or you think a friend offended you, or you think a co-worker's being a little rude, then you're screwed because you're worrying about the
wrong things. Spend that energy on solving big problems and you accomplish big things.
